feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag pumasok sa daloy ng sasakyan, ipagpaliban ang tawag para sa mahabang history, o manghula ng emergency number.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not step into moving traffic, delay the call for a full history, or assume a national number replaces the locally verified contact.
